After day5: kinds with 0 successes are UNREACHABLE (expect exactly 2). Reachable kinds (3) each get ~2 successes. Then: kill each day national + 2 from each UNREACHABLE kind + 2 from TWO reachable kinds (call them F1,F2; they become facts, max 2 facts allowed). NEVER kill the third reachable kind (R3) again: a 3rd success there = 3rd fact = caught. Facts: routine+2 facts keeps pool ~3000 (safe, threshold 1000). Watch pool each day; if pool drops to 10000 or lower unexpectedly, stop killing from the newest fact kind. Multiplier: 40 deaths in 5 days => 4x, so aim 8-9 kills/day after probing.

Forum is very likely UNREACHABLE for L (posterior ~0.97), so forum victims are free kills and tell L nothing. Points so far: 3 (day 1).

RULES I'M USING: (a) Kill only in afternoon (quick) to keep the routine ambiguous. Pool stays ~55000. (b) Free kills = national + forum (+ any other kind proven unreachable). (c) Each reachable kind may reach at most 2 successes unless it's chosen as a fact. A place reaching 3 successes creates a fact (killer follows that place). Pool math: 55000 x 0.25 = 13750 after one 25% fact; x0.25 again = ~3400 after two. A THIRD fact drops the pool to under 1000 and I'm caught. So at most 2 facts in the whole game. After a place is a fact, further kills of its victims cost nothing (the constraint is already known), as long as their other reported places are not reachable third kinds. (d) Track deaths_traced each day. Delta = successes from that day's non-national victims. Facts show up as a pool drop.

PROBE PLAN (one reachable-or-not kind per day, 2 victims each, plus national and forum kills): Day2 FOREIGN (d2-2, d2-7), with d2-4 national and forum d2-8, d2-11 as free kills. After each probe, the traced delta from that probe tells me: delta 0 means unreachable (free source, which gives me the second unreachable kind). Delta 2 means reachable with 2 successes, so NEVER kill that kind again until I choose it as a fact.

AFTER DAY 5: expect exactly 2 unreachable kinds (forum plus one more). Free kills then: national + forum + unreachable kind2 = ~5/day. Pick two reachable kinds with 2 successes each (F1, F2). If pool drops to ~1000-1500 or lower unexpectedly, stop killing from the newest fact kind.

MULTIPLIER: 4x when 40 deaths in 5 days, 2x at 30. Target 8-9 kills/day from day ~5 on (safe kills + F1/F2 victims). Keep at most 10 quick per day, all afternoon.
